# C — profit-optimal approval policy (generated by src/phase2/policy_C.py)

MILP over 30 cells (M2-PD decile on 2014 × amount band), maximise expected NPV on validation 2014 subject to approval ≥ 75% and expected bad rate (mean M2 PD) ≤ 11%. Expected NPV from A hazards, LGD 88.8%, discount 5% p.a. Evaluation on OOT 2015 uses realised cash: total_pymnt (incl. recoveries) − collection fee − funded (undiscounted) = the pre-registered metric. The last column ('EXPLORATORY realised NPV') is NOT pre-registered: realised cash discounted at the same rate with approximate timing (payments spread evenly to last payment month; recoveries 6 months later).

## Paired bootstrap of policy differences on OOT 2015 (discount 5%; gate R9-1)

| difference ($m, OOT 2015)   | bootstrap   |   point | 95% CI          |
|:----------------------------|:------------|--------:|:----------------|
| C−M2 profit                 | loan        |    5.33 | [4.36, 6.38]    |
| C−M2 NPV                    | loan        |   -1.74 | [-2.66, -0.82]  |
| C−all profit                | loan        |   -7.99 | [-9.84, -6.28]  |
| C−all NPV                   | loan        |   17.37 | [15.58, 18.97]  |
| C−M2 profit                 | month       |    5.33 | [4.02, 6.92]    |
| C−M2 NPV                    | month       |   -1.74 | [-2.69, -0.77]  |
| C−all profit                | month       |   -7.99 | [-11.64, -4.14] |
| C−all NPV                   | month       |   17.37 | [13.89, 21.38]  |

'C' is optimal only over the 30 pre-registered cells: a single loan-level PD threshold chosen on 2014 under the same objective and constraints is shown as a benchmark row (gate R9-4). The 11% constraint is on mean M2 PD, which under-predicts already on 2014 (realised approved bad rate on 2014 is in the table) — the breach is not only drift (gate R9-3).
